title: Stable influence bound
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ take values in $[-1,1]$, let $0\le\rho\le1$, and let $i\in[n]$. The stable influence of $f$ at coordinate $i$ with parameter $\rho$ is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a bounded cube function, with all values in [−1,1]
